fetch_url.description: The clone fetch URL (interface: Clone resolution): the URL of repos.<id>.remote, userinfo stripped, normalized to the repo id, unchanged by ls-remote --get-url; stored with the clone and verified on every resolution. Push target of the clean checkout.

default_branch.description: The remote's default branch, read from the mirror's HEAD as set by its last refresh (never from the clone); null if the mirror was never refreshed.

cloned.description: false: the repo already resolved, or the destination already held a clone of it, and that clone is returned.

anchors.description: The clone's common-dir anchor when its identity differed from the recorded one and a human re-accepted it (with mount information); empty otherwise.

dry_run.description: true: what the command would do; nothing was changed and no hooks ran.
